name: DataStack
role: Deploys the full Mat-O-Lab PMD-CKAN platform as a containerized stack for FAIR materials-science data management in decentralised linked-data spaces.

live_instances.name: Future Car Production Materials Data Space

services.name: nginx
services.role: Reverse proxy, TLS termination, internal routing

services.name: ckan
services.role: CKAN data portal with all Mat-O-Lab extensions

networks: datastack_net (internal bridge — all services share this)

config_convention.description: Every .env variable prefixed CKANINI__ is auto-translated to ckan.ini at container start

critical_env_vars.description: CKAN API token used by ALL background-job extensions (csvtocsvw, csvwmapandtransform, fuseki). Must be created manually after first boot. Stack will NOT auto-process resources without this.
CKAN session secret — must be set before deploy
Public hostname for TLS and CKAN_SITE_URL
JVM heap for Fuseki — tune for host memory
Public URL for MapToMethod (used in browser iframes — must be publicly accessible)
Sparklis UI URL — empty uses built-in YASGUI

post_boot_setup: Create an admin API token at /user/<admin>/api-tokens
Create a CKAN group named exactly 'mappings' (case-sensitive) — required by ckanext-csvwmapandtransform
most_common_setup_failure: BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN not set — extensions run but background jobs never execute; no CSV annotation, no RDF conversion, no Fuseki sync happens
capabilities: Automated CSV → semantic data pipeline on upload (via extensions)
All components deploy with a single docker compose up
known_limitations: BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN is a manual post-boot step — stack will not auto-process resources without it
Fuseki auto-sync hooks are commented out in ckanext-fuseki — Fuseki upload requires manual trigger via CKAN UI or API
rmlmapper is hardcoded to port 4000; cannot be changed without rebuilding the image
Data sources must be publicly accessible URLs for URL-based microservice endpoints (upload endpoints exist as fallback)
Fuseki JVM heap set to 10 GB by default — tune for host memory
